title: Overview

topTables.campaignsHint: A campaign is a set of traffic and routing settings. Shows the campaigns with the most clicks in the period.
topTables.countriesHint: Visitor country from IP. "Undefined" means the country could not be determined.
topTables.flowsHint: A flow is the variant a click was routed to inside the campaign's stream sets. When several flows share a name, the campaign is shown in brackets.
topTables.clicksHint: All clicks in the period, including repeat clicks from the same visitor.
topTables.cvrHint: CVR = conversions ÷ clicks × 100%. The share of clicks that ended in a conversion.
topTables.revenueHint: Revenue from conversions in USD at the rate on the event date, net of chargebacks: a declined first purchase is subtracted on the day of the decline.
topTables.roiHint: ROI = (revenue − cost) ÷ cost × 100%. "—" when no cost is entered.
topTables.offersHint: The offer a click was routed to. Offers that received conversions in the period, by revenue.

comparedWith: Changes are against the previous period of the same length: {{from}} – {{to}}.

unpriced.title_one: {{count}} conversion's revenue is missing from the reports
unpriced.title_other: {{count}} conversions' revenue is missing from the reports
unpriced.description: These conversions have no USD amount: there is no exchange rate for their date, or the postback came without a currency. Revenue, profit and ROI above are lower by their amount.

firstSteps.title: First steps: {{done}} of {{total}}
firstSteps.description: What is left before your first conversion shows up here. Steps tick themselves from your data.
firstSteps.unknown: Could not be checked: the click store is unavailable right now.

source.title: Add a traffic source
source.hint: Where the traffic comes from: Facebook, TikTok, a push network…

network.title: Add a conversion source
network.hint: A partner network whose offers you send traffic to, or your own site that reports its purchases itself.

mapping.title: Map the statuses
mapping.hint: For example reg → CPA_HOLD, purchase → CPA_ACCEPT. Without it postbacks are refused. An own site's statuses are ready at once.

offer.title: Add an offer
offer.hint: An offer link, or your site's, with the {click_id} macro — that is how it comes back in the postback.

campaign.title: Create a campaign with a tracking link
campaign.hint: An active campaign and the link you put in your ads.

click.title: Get a first click
click.hint: Open the campaign's tracking link yourself — the click shows up in the log.

conversion.title: Get a first conversion
conversion.hint: Give the incoming postback URL to the network or to your site's developer — it is on the source's page.

cost.title: Enter spend
cost.hint: No spend, no profit or ROI. Enter it on the campaign or connect an ad account.

unmapped.title_one: {{count}} postback is waiting for its status to be mapped
unmapped.title_other: {{count}} postbacks are waiting for their status to be mapped
unmapped.description: A network sent statuses no event mapping knows: {{statuses}}. These conversions are not in the reports yet — map the statuses and they are recorded with their own date.
